title: Church of Saint Euphemianos, Lysi

buildingCutout.basis: Named 8.58 by 7.70 m mapped chapel envelope, OpenStreetMap way 190662188.

terrainReference.basis: Original public source terrain by the photographed side entrance.

mapIdentity.provider: Named OpenStreetMap chapel way 190662188, with the Cyprus Department of Antiquities and the exact Qualla exterior photographs.
mapIdentity.scope: The named OSM way provides an 8.58 by 7.70 m bounding rectangle. The south entrance view and east apse view determine the main roof and wall offsets and the round apse. The two views share one documented appearance date.

note: Exterior wall heights, the side doorway, drum and dome rise estimated from photographic proportions. Original public terrain places the doorway threshold within its local grade. Model units are metres.
